title: Caryocar coriaceum Wittm. fruit extracts as Leishmania inhibitors: in-vitro and in-silico approaches.
authors: Tomiotto-Pellissier, Fernanda; Alves, Daniela Ribeiro; Morais, Selene Maia de; Bortoleti, Bruna Taciane da Silva; Goncalves, Manoela Daiele; Silva, Taylon Felipe; Tavares, Eliandro Reis; Yamauchi, Lucy Megumi; Costa, Idessania Nazareth; Marinho, Emmanuel Silva; Marinho, Marcia Machado; Conchon-Costa, Ivete; Miranda-Sapla, Milena Menegazzo; Pavanelli, Wander Rogerio
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Caryocar coriaceum果实提取物抗利什曼原虫的体外与分子对接实验，对象为寄生虫蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Leishmaniasis is a group of neglected diseases caused by parasites of the Leishmania genus. The treatment of Leishmaniasis represents a great challenge, because the available drugs present high toxicity and none of them is fully effective. Caryocar is a botanical genus rich in phenolic compounds, which leaves extracts have already been described by its antileishmanial action. Thus, we investigated the effect of pulp and peel extracts of the Caryocar coriaceum fruit on promastigote and amastigote forms of Leishmania amazonensis. Both extracts had antipromastigote effect after 24, 48, and 72 h, and this effect was by apoptosis-like process induction, with reactive oxygen species (ROS) production, damage to the mitochondria and plasma membrane, and phosphatidylserine exposure. Knowing that the fruit extracts did not alter the viability of macrophages, we observed that the treatment reduced the infection of these cells. Thereafter, in the in vitro infection context, the extracts showed antioxidant proprieties, by reducing NO, ROS, and MDA levels. Besides, both peel and pulp extracts up-regulated Nrf2/HO-1/Ferritin expression and increase the total iron-bound in infected macrophages, which culminates in a depletion of available iron for L. amazonensis replication. In silico, the molecular modeling experiments showed that the three flavonoids presented in the C. coriaceum extracts can act as synergistic inhibitors of Leishmania proteins, and compete for the active site. Also, there is a preference for rutin at the active site due to its greater interaction binding strength.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 利什曼病是一组由利什曼原虫属（Leishmania）寄生虫引起的被忽视疾病。利什曼病的治疗面临巨大挑战，因为现有药物毒性高且无一完全有效。Caryocar 是一个富含酚类化合物的植物属，其叶片提取物已被描述具有抗利什曼作用。因此，我们研究了Caryocar coriaceum果实果肉和果皮提取物对亚马逊利什曼原虫（Leishmania amazonensis）前鞭毛体和无鞭毛体形式的影响。两种提取物在24、48和72小时后均具有抗前鞭毛体效果，且该效果通过类凋亡过程诱导实现，伴随活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS）产生、线粒体和质膜损伤以及磷脂酰丝氨酸暴露。鉴于果实提取物未改变巨噬细胞活力，我们观察到处理降低了这些细胞的感染率。随后，在体外感染背景下，提取物通过降低NO、ROS和MDA水平表现出抗氧化特性。此外，果皮和果肉提取物均上调了Nrf2/HO-1/Ferritin表达，并增加了感染巨噬细胞中总铁结合量，最终导致可用于亚马逊利什曼原虫复制的铁耗竭。在计算机模拟中，分子建模实验表明，C. coriaceum提取物中存在的三种黄酮类化合物可作为利什曼原虫蛋白的协同抑制剂，并竞争活性位点。同时，由于芦丁（rutin）具有更强的结合相互作用强度，其在活性位点表现出优先性。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
